bio: Roads fringed by almond trees and terraced vines lead to this stunning hillside spot with far-reaching views over Lake Balaton. It’s a restful place and comes with seven restored wine press houses which now play host to designer bedrooms with private saunas. Within the grounds sits this beautiful whitewashed restaurant with a simple bistro-cum-farmhouse style and a lovely terrace affording stunning views out over the vines towards Lake Balaton in the distance. The generous cooking has an equally Mediterranean feel, with bright colours and bold, contrasting flavours....
